notes: Dress for dirt: long pants, closed-toe shoes, layers. Poison ivy can be present. Children must come with a registered adult. Volunteers under 14 must have an adult with them for the whole shift, and a parent or guardian must sign the waiver for volunteers under 18. Seasonal paid park jobs exist but the page did not state a minimum age.
name: Metroparks Volunteer Workdays
city: Southeast Michigan (parks include Hudson Mills, Dexter-Huron, Stony Creek, Willow)
what_you_do: Spend a morning pulling invasive plants, planting trees or gathering native seeds with the park natural resources team. Tools and gloves are provided.
who_can_apply: Ages 12 and up. Children must come with a registered adult.
deadline_text: Workdays run through the year. Sign up by noon the day before each one. The workdays listed on the page were July 11, Aug 22 and Sept 26 (the page does not show the year).
how_to_apply: Pick a workday on the volunteering page and register online by noon the day before. For regular volunteering, send the application and waiver to volunteer@metroparks.com.
